title: Pilobol.us P3-04: publication repo scaffold on the published packages (brand moved, newsroom at /newsroom, infra/site.json)
description:
## Goal
Turn AnthusAI/Pilobol.us into a standard publication repo that depends on the published Papyrus packages (one repo for the CMS app and the reader, per docs/standard-site.md 1.2 and 1.6), on a branch only. Nothing is deployed from this ticket.

## Context (FACT, verified 2026-10-06)
- Repo AnthusAI/Pilobol.us is PUBLIC (no secrets may enter it), default branch main (production reader deploys from it), no branch protection. Tracked: the newsroom pod (stories/ 22 PILO stories, project/, corpora/, skills/, scout notes, 759 files) plus web/ (reader: build_via_papyrus.py, pilobol_feed.py, css/, content/). Root package.json only has puppeteer; root amplify.yml is the READER build spec.
- Packages: npm @anthusai/papyrus dist-tag next = 1.0.0-next.8 (latest = 0.0.0 placeholder); PyPI papyrus-newsroom 1.0.0.dev8 (Python >=3.12). npm peer deps: next ^15.5.18, react ^19.2.6, react-dom ^19.2.6, constructs, aws-cdk-lib, @aws-amplify/backend ^1.22.0, @aws-amplify/backend-cli ^1.8.2, @aws-amplify/seed. Install is heavy (~1.8 GB with the backend deps).
- Brand today lives in Papyrus: publications/pilobol_us/brand.ts (id pilobol-us), theme.css, and PILOBOL_US_THEME_PACK_TOKENS in lib/site-stack.ts; corpora/pilobol-us-*.yml; publications/pilobolus/ (editorial-rewrite-skill.yml, style-profile.yml, reference-samples). Papyrus develop registers the brand in repo-root papyrus.config.ts; the packages ship no publications/*.
- The current brand has newsroomBasePath "" and rootRoute newsroom (newsroom at the site root). With static staging this loops (anonymous / -> /newsroom -> / ...; middleware.ts usesNewsroomRootPaths + the preview gate). The migrated brand must use newsroomBasePath "/newsroom" and rootRoute redirect to /newsroom.
- Backend needs secrets PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET, OPENAI_API_KEY (knowledgeQuery), GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET when Google is on: all Amplify secrets (SSM), never in the repo.

## Exact steps (branch feature/PPY-<id>-publication-scaffold in a worktree of the Pilobol.us repo)
1. package.json (replace puppeteer-only file; keep puppeteer as a devDependency if the screenshot scripts need it): dependencies @anthusai/papyrus pinned EXACT to the newest 1.0.0-next.N at the time (today 1.0.0-next.8), plus the peer deps at the ranges above, devDependencies typescript. Generate the lock from scratch (npm install in a clean dir; a swapped tarball breaks npm ci, see standard-site 1.4). Add scripts: dev, build (papyrus-app sync && next build), predev/prebuild sync.
2. next.config.mjs using withPapyrus; tsconfig.json with the paths papyrus-site, papyrus-amplify-outputs, papyrus-site-theme and declare module "*.css" (see standard-site 1.4); .gitignore additions (.next, amplify_outputs.json, cdk.out, content-export, web/dist-papyrus stays).
3. papyrus.config.ts: defineSite({ brands: [pilobolUsBrand], defaultBrand: "pilobol-us", backend: { brandId: "pilobol-us", auth: { redirectUrls: [...], cognitoDomainPrefix: "papyrus-pilobol-us", disableGoogleOAuth: false }, reader: { amplifyAppId: "d1od6t7lzbwanr", branchName: "main" }, stagingBuild: { enabled: true }, features: { consoleResponder: false, inboundEmail: false, slack: false, storageBackups: false } } }). The redirect URLs equal the live branch value plus the staging origin (read the live names only; the URL list is not secret but do not paste env values into tickets beyond this list). Brand moves from Papyrus publications/pilobol_us/brand.ts with the two newsroom fields changed and the theme tokens inlined (copy PILOBOL_US_THEME_PACK_TOKENS from lib/site-stack.ts).
4. publication/theme.css (copy of publications/pilobol_us/theme.css), amplify/backend.ts and amplify/data/resource.ts as the one-line re-exports from @anthusai/papyrus/backend (see standard-site 1.2), corpora/pilobol-us-{steering,newsroom-sections,analysis-profiles}.yml (copied), publication/ editorial files from publications/pilobolus (copied).
5. infra/ (its own app): package.json (@anthusai/papyrus same pin, aws-cdk-lib, constructs), site.json (siteId pilobol-us, repository, brand, frontend markus-static, hostedZoneId Z09961547QX1VHIXOBD7, papyrusVersion, cms + reader.amplifyAppId, github block for OIDC; adopt-mode fields from the infra adoption ticket).
6. .github/workflows/ci.yml: npm ci --dry-run (root and infra), tsc --noEmit, papyrus-infra synth, python -m papyrus_content brand check if available. No secrets.
7. Do NOT touch web/, amplify.yml or AGENTS.md here.
8. In a scratch copy: PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND=pilobol-us npm run build succeeds; npx papyrus-infra synth --site infra/site.json succeeds.

## Acceptance checks
- npm ci --dry-run exits 0 in root and infra; npm run build exits 0 in scratch with PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND=pilobol-us (and fails with an unknown id: BRD gate: ids are exact).
- The brand object has newsroomBasePath "/newsroom" and rootRoute redirect; grep shows no secret value in the diff.
- git diff --stat shows nothing under web/ or amplify.yml.

## Rollback
Close the PR and delete the branch; main is untouched.

## Risks
- Repo is public: no env values, no amplify_outputs.json.
- A root Next app next to a root amplify.yml: while amplify.yml exists on a branch, Amplify (ASSUMPTION: repo-level amplify.yml wins over app-level specs) would run the reader spec for the CMS app on that branch. The proof branch deletes amplify.yml; main keeps it until the reader-spec ticket.
- Prerelease pins can disappear or change behavior (npm next tag moves): pin exact, never ^.

## Needs Ryan
Decision D1 (one repo) and D3 (prerelease pin) in the plan.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.
right_now_summary: The publication repo scaffold is being prepared on a feature branch without touching production files.
